xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe: Effective November 21, 2025, the Government of India has notified four Labour Codes ('New Labour Codes'), which have consolidated and replaced 29 existing labour laws. While the supporting Rules and certain key clarifications are awaited, the Company has accounted for an amount of ~ 787 Lakhs towards the estimated impact of the changes brought about by the New Labour Codes in respect of employee benefit expenses and disclosed the same as an exceptional item in its financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025. The Company continues to monitor the finalisation of the Rules as well as clarifications / notifications issued by the Government and the above impact estimates shall be re-assessed and finalised based on the final Rules and industry practices.
